scenario: The ego vehicle travels on a narrow rural road and encounters an adversarial car overtaking it on the left, followed by a pedestrian and a tricycle on the road ahead.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward along the narrow rural road and maintains its lane after being overtaken.

adversarials.behavior: The car overtakes the ego vehicle from the left side and continues driving straight ahead in the same lane.
The pedestrian is walking along the right side of the road in the same direction as traffic.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle is on a narrow two-lane rural road flanked by bare trees and scattered buildings. An adversarial car starts to the left and slightly behind the ego, then moves ahead. A pedestrian is positioned on the right roadside ahead of the ego.
